_README.description: MiniMax via its OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, MINIMAX_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.minimax.io/v1. M3 weights are open but 428B, so the API is the practical route. Scores pinned to the minimax/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: MiniMax M3 - multimodal MoE (428B, 1M context) for coding and long-running agents. Direct MiniMax API.
